newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends range trading easier vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends range trading easier vs dlr.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed slightly lower against the dollar after tracking an idle dollar/mark in rangebound trading, dealers said on Friday.
"The dollar/mark hardly did anything and we followed it," Magyar Befektetesi es Fejlesztesi Bank's Levente Fulop said.
The forint finished at 154.45/50 to one dollar, pushed down by the mark's weakening versus the dollar from an opening of 154.33/38 forint/dollar.
Dealers said the forint remained pinned to the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) resistance level (bid) all day.
The forint floats within the NBH's 4.5 percent wide intervention range, against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the Ecu.
Mark and yen futures closed mixed on the Budapest Commodity Exchange, the dollar rose for almost all maturities, while the Ecu mainly weakened.
